_comment: Template for annotate-film-scans settings. Copy this file up one level (into the settings directory itself) or merge its contents into settings.json, then replace the example entries. Files in templates/ are never loaded. Entry names are what you use on the command line (--camera etc.) and in shot-info files. An entry with the same name as a built-in one replaces it; an entry set to null removes it. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Run 'annotate-film-scans --check-settings' after editing.
